meta.notes: Edges filtered: reference===18 AND type==='bechina'. 16 bechina edges yielded 12 raw connected components across 28 unique nodes. Small isolated pairs (2-node components) were merged into the most thematically appropriate larger component by SHARED NATURE only, never by cause-and-effect. The evil pair (הסתרת פני השם / כעס) is kept as a standalone evil-polarity package — it is the mirror of Package 3, not its cause.

packages.label: שְׁלֵמוּת הָאוֹתִיּוֹת וְהַתַּכְלִית
packages.label_en: Perfection of Letters and Ultimate Purpose
packages.reason: This cluster centers on the teaching's grand unifying insight: the perfection of the letters of speech IS the ultimate purpose of all creation, and that purpose IS the letter yud, which IS the World to Come. All nodes in this package share the same essential nature — the domain of divine speech-letters at their point of completion. 'אשת' (wife) is an acronym-bechina of the letters aleph-shin-tav ('אבנים שלמות תבנה'); 'אותיות' are the building-blocks of creation; 'שפה ברורה' and 'שלמות הדבור' are the realized form of perfected speech; 'תכלת' is an explicit bechina of 'תכלית'; 'שלמות האותיות של דבורי אמונה' and 'אשת רבי חנינא בן דוסא' are the same reality from two angles (the letters-of-faith quality that belongs to the tzaddik's household). The dominant node 'שלמות האותיות' has the highest degree (2) and appears in two key edges: connecting to 'אות יו"ד' (the completion-point of every letter) and to 'תכלית של כל הנבראים' (the telos of all existence).

merge_notes.reason: The text states explicitly: 'אֵשֶׁת זֶה בְּחִינוֹת הָאוֹתִיּוֹת, שֶׁשְּׁלֵמוּתָם עַל-יְדֵי אֱמוּנָה, בִּבְחִינַת רָאשֵׁי תֵּבוֹת: אֲבָנִים שְׁלֵמוֹת תִּבְנֶה'. The word 'אשת' (wife) IS the letters — they share the same essential nature as the rest of the letters-cluster. Not merged into emunah because the shared nature here is the letter-domain itself, not the faith-quality.

Edge 481 bechina: perfection of letters of faith-speech = wife of R. Chanina ben Dosa. This pair belongs with the letters-package because its essential nature is the completed letters of speech (דבורי אמונה), not the emunah-quality itself. The 'אשת' (wife) dimension is the letters, as established above.

Edge 2939 bechina: pure speech = perfect speech. 'שפה ברורה' (clear language) IS 'שלמות הדבור' (perfection of speech). Both are aspects of the same domain as 'שלמות האותיות' — the completion of divine language. Merged into the letters-package.

Edge 3125 bechina: the blue dye (תכלת) IS the ultimate purpose (תכלית). The text says this explicitly. Since 'תכלית' is essentially synonymous with 'תכלית של כל הנבראים' (both appear in the same teaching passage describing the same theological referent — the purpose that letters point toward), this pair merges into the letters-completion cluster which already contains 'תכלית של כל הנבראים'.

packages.label: אֱמוּנָה וְרַבִּי חֲנִינָא
packages.label_en: Faith and Rabbi Chanina ben Dosa
packages.reason: This cluster unites all nodes that share the essential quality of simple, steadfast faith (אמונה). Rabbi Chanina ben Dosa is a bechina of faith because his defining quality is 'a qav of carobs' — minimal material sustenance sustained entirely by divine trust. The carobs (חרובין) ARE the beroshim-tree (ברושים) ARE the biyarsha-fish (בירשא) — all of these are bechina expressions of the same quality: the minimal sustenance that characterizes pure faith. The scriptural formula 'לִקְרֹא כֻלָּם בְּשֵׁם ה'' is an explicit bechina of emunah in the text. The dominant node 'אמונה' has the highest degree in this cluster (2 edges: to 'לקרא כלם בשם ה'' and to 'רבי חנינא בן דוסא'), making it the natural cluster-head.

merge_notes.reason: This raw component (edges 539+573: חרובין↔ברושים↔בירשא) describes three plant/fish metaphors that are bechina-equivalents of each other. The source text makes explicit that חרובין = ברושים = בירשא = the expression of R. Chanina's faith-quality ('קב חרובין – מדת אמונה; חרובין – בחינת ברושים, בחינת בירשא'). All three are aspects of the same domain as אמונה — the sparse, ascetic vehicle through which faith is expressed. Merged into the emunah cluster on grounds of shared essential nature.

packages.label: רַחֲמָנוּת וְעֲטָרָה
packages.reason: This cluster groups all nodes sharing the essential nature of rachamim (divine mercy) as the quality that sweetens anger and crowns the humble tzaddik. 'עטרה' (crown) IS 'רחמנות' (mercy) — the crown IS the quality of mercy, and this is an explicit bechina in the text. 'יַמְתִּיק הַכַּעַס בְּרַחֲמָנוּת' and its scriptural bechina 'בְּרֹגֶז רַחֵם תִּזְכּוֹר' both express the same essential act — the transformation of anger into mercy that defines righteous leadership. The dominant node is 'רחמנות' — it connects the crown-concept (עטרה) with the practice of sweetening (ימתיק), making it the conceptual hub of this package.

merge_notes.reason: This raw 2-node component (edge 20) describes the essential practice of sweetening anger through mercy, with the verse 'בְּרֹגֶז רַחֵם תִּזְכּוֹר' as its scriptural expression. Its core concept is רחמנות — shared nature with the עטרה↔רחמנות pair (edge 2740). Merged here because both pairs describe the same essential quality: mercy that transforms anger into a crown. This is NOT merged into Package 4 (Malkhut) even though rachamim leads to leadership — that causal flow is eitza, not bechina.

packages.label: מַלְכוּת וְחֲכָמִים
packages.reason: This cluster unites the domain of holy kingship and its proper foundation in wisdom. 'מלכות' IS 'הנהגה' (leadership/governance) — they share the same essential nature: sovereign ordering of a community. 'משפט' (justice/law) IS 'חכמים' (sages) — the text derives this from Leviticus 26: 'if you despise my mishpatim' = 'one who hates the sages.' Therefore mishpat and chachamim are bechina-equivalents, both describing the wisdom-dimension that makes kingship sustainable. The text says explicitly: 'עיקר המלכות שרשה בחכמה... על ידי ראשי עם, שהם המוחין והחכמה, על ידם תיכון בחינת המלכות.' Wisdom/sages IS the foundation of malkhut — they share the same structural domain.

merge_notes.reason: Edge 1177 bechina: mishpat = chachamim, derived from 'ואם את משפטי תגעל נפשכם — זה השונא את החכמים.' Both nodes describe the same domain: the wisdom-principle that upholds kingship. Merged with the מלכות↔הנהגה pair because all four nodes share the essential nature of holy, wisdom-grounded governance. This is NOT a causal merge — the teaching is that the essence of malkhut IS the chachamim/mishpat quality, not merely that sages cause good governance.

packages.label: הַסְתָּרַת פְּנֵי הַשֵּׁם וְהַכַּעַס
packages.reason: This is the evil mirror of Package 3 (Rachamim/Crown). Where Package 3 describes anger SWEETENED into mercy (the good pole), Package 5 describes anger NOT sweetened — the result being divine hiddenness (hester panim). The text is explicit: 'הַהַסְתָּרָה הַזֹּאת הִיא בְּחִינוֹת כַּעְסוֹ וַחֲרוֹן-אַפּוֹ' — the hiding of God's face IS His anger. This bechina-pair (edge 1518) represents the negative pole of the Torah's central dynamic. Unlike the good cluster where the tzaddik sweetens anger with rachamim, here the anger remains un-sweetened, producing divine withdrawal and preventing proper leadership of the world. This package stands alone as a 2-node evil component — it is kept separate from Package 3 even though the teaching discusses them together, because they are opposite polarities of the same coin (not the same essential nature).
